id: title:frankh:point the dev trace spans mv at writable trace spans

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the ClickHouse migration for trace spans to distinguish Cloud Dev mode, routing the materialized view creation to writable_trace_spans on APM nodes rather than the standard trace_spans on LOGS nodes.
review.reason: Adds a conditional variable `_is_dev` and a new MV object `_mv` that selects either the APM or LOGS role, and uses `_mv` instead of the previous default MV in the migration operations. P1.F1.H1: P1.F2.H1: P1.F1.H1: P1.F2.H1
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of a Cloud Dev mode and its operational requirements, which are not independently verified in this chunk. The score is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded capability and its relevance to a specific operational path, not on unverified adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are supplied. No other hunks exist. No unrelated PRs are supplied, so no uncertainty flag is needed. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional variable `_is_dev` and a new MV object `_mv` that selects either the APM or LOGS role, and uses `_mv` instead of the previous default MV in the migration operations.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the ClickHouse migration for trace spans to distinguish Cloud Dev mode, routing the materialized view creation to the writable_trace_spans table on APM nodes rather than the standard trace_spans on LOGS nodes, while retaining the original behavior for other modes.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameter `to_table` to the KAFKA_TRACE_SPANS_AVRO_MV function, allowing the target table name to be supplied, and updates the SQL to use this parameter.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the migration to specify the destination table for the materialized view, supporting the Cloud Dev mode requirement to write to writable_trace_spans instead of the default trace_spans.
